title: Spectral inequalities for magnetic Neumann Laplacian on rectangles
summary: We consider the magnetic Neumann Laplacian on rectangles, subject to non-homogeneous fields. We prove that the square is a local minimiser of the lowest eigenvalue among all rectangles of a fixed area for weak magnetic fields . We conjecture that it is a global minimiser both under the area or perimeter constraints and partially prove the conjecture by establishing lower and upper bounds to the principal eigenvalue.
